stopCheckReject.title: Stop
stopCheckReject.para: Does a call, email or text seem off? The best thing to do is stop. Take a breath. Real organisations won’t put you under pressure to act instantly.

stopCheckReject.title: Check
stopCheckReject.para: Ask someone you trust or contact the organisation the message claims to be from.

stopCheckReject.title: Reject
stopCheckReject.para: If you’re unsure, hang up on the caller, delete the email, block the phone number. Change your password if you think someone else may have it, and make sure you pick something long and unique.

thingsYouShould.heading: Things You Should Know
paraGraph: DigitalDSA Will Never Request Sensitive Information: DigitalDSA will never ask you to transfer funds, share your screen, reveal your passwords, or provide sensitive personal details over phone, email, or messages. Be cautious of any such requests claiming to be from us.

Beware of Fraudulent Communications: Cybercriminals may impersonate DigitalDSA, banks, or financial institutions via emails, phone calls, or messages to trick you into making payments or sharing personal information. Always verify the authenticity of any request before responding.

Protect Your Business & Personal Accounts: Set up strong, unique passwords for all your accounts, enable multi-factor authentication, and avoid clicking on suspicious links or attachments. Always verify payment requests directly through a trusted contact method before transferring funds.

Recognizing & Preventing Scams: Common scams include business email compromise (BEC), remote access fraud, and impersonation scams. If you receive unexpected requests for payments, changes in account details, or threats of legal action, pause, verify, and report immediately.

Report Suspected Cyber Fraud: If you suspect a scam or fraudulent activity, report it immediately to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal or call the Government of India’s Cybercrime Helpline at 1930. Prompt action can help prevent financial loss and safeguard your business.

DigitalDSA’s Limited Liability: DigitalDSA is not liable for any financial loss, unauthorized transactions, or damages resulting from cyber fraud or third-party scams. Users are responsible for securing their accounts and verifying all communications independently.
